newsitem.title: USA: Cilluffo group cuts Stone&Webster stake.
newsitem.headline: Cilluffo group cuts Stone&Webster stake.

text.p: A group led by Cilluffo Associates L.P. said Monday it cut its stake in Stone & Webster Inc to 9.96 percent or 1,318,971 common shares.
In a filing with Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 300,000 shares Sept 9 to Stone & Webster at $32.43375 per share.
The group sold the shares in order to increase the flexibility and liquidity of its overall investments portfolio, the filing said.

Because Stone & Webster is undergoing a "seminal change" that should yield meaningful returns in the intermediate and long-term future, the group said it will not resubmit its previously withdrawn proposal at the 1997 annual meeting.
In March the group dropped a plan to seek board action to sell, distribute or spin off all businesses and assets of Stone & Webster except its engineering and construction operations.
